title: Creamy Coleslaw (Raw Vegan)
excerpt: Hello Summer! This delicious creamy coleslaw is the perfect dish to bring to any bbq or picnic. Your friends won’t even know it’s dairy free (or raw vegan)!
content:
Ingredients

  • Ingredients:
  • 4 cups thinly sliced green cabbage
  • ½ cup thinly sliced red cabbage
  • ½ cup shredded carrots
  • Dressing:
  • Blend until very creamy
  • ¼ cup lemon juice 1 clove garlic
  • 1 t celery seeds
  • ½ t mustard powder
  • 3 cups parsnips, chopped 1 cup sesame oil
  • ¾ cup water
  • 5 drops stevia, optional

Method

  1. Toss everything together in a large mixing bowl. This makes a wonderful picnic salad.
